name: fix73_orbit
verifies: fix-73: the port option 'Q / E: Orbit camera' — holding Q orbits the camera round the standing hero (camera yaw moves away from the hero's, the hero does not turn), the orbit holds while he stands and swings back behind him when he walks; with a weapon drawn and with the option off Q turns the hero as in G3 (150°/s)
notes: Run in the editor (camrel = |camera yaw - hero yaw|; keyturnhero = the hero's turn during the last 'turnkey'). Orbit speed 110°/s: 1 s ≈ 110°, 1.8 s ≈ 198° wraps to ~162°. Screens: fix73_orbit_side (hero seen from his left side), fix73_orbit_front (from the front). After 'move fwd' the camera is back behind him (ease 0.35 s).
